paragraphs: Founded in 2012, The Honest Company (the "Company," or "Honest," or which may also be referred to as "we," "us" or "our") is a personal care company dedicated to creating cleanly-formulated and sustainably-designed products for everyone from babies to adults. By combining thoughtful design with science-based innovation, we deliver personal care products for everyone from babies to adults, spanning categories across wipes, personal care, diapers, and beauty. Our commitment to our core values, continual innovation and engaging our community has differentiated and elevated our brand and our products. Since our launch, we have cultivated deep trust around what matters most to our consumers: their health, their families and their homes. We seek to meet consumers wherever they want to shop, balancing deep consumer connection with broad convenience and availability. We believe our distribution strategy positions us for continued growth through our trusted brand and award-winning multi-category product offering.

Our Chief Executive Officer, as the chief operating decision maker, organizes the Company, manages resource allocations, and measures performance on the basis of one operating segment. We offer an array of cleanly-formulated and sustainably-designed products, including a portfolio of wipes and a personal care collection for everyone from babies to adults, as well as diapers. We use cleanly-formulated and safe ingredients designed for the whole family, including many naturally-derived ingredients that, most importantly, are effective. We also offer a portfolio of wipes, including all-purpose wipes, flushable wipes in both toddler and adult variations, sanitizing wipes, and make-up remover wipes. Our Clean Conscious® wipes are compostable and plant-based, made with over 99% water and designed to protect delicate skin. We have an extensive collection of personal care products for everyone from babies to adults, as well as adult facial care products designed for a range of skin types and concerns, many of which are certified by trusted experts and institutions, including the National Eczema Association. Our ingredients and formulas are toxicologist-audited for potential health concerns. Primary components of our diapers include responsibly sourced, plant-based fluff pulp and other plant-derived materials. Our diapers have an extensive modern and efficient design that uses less material.

We seek to meet consumers wherever they want to shop, balancing deep consumer connection with broad convenience and availability. Our distribution strategy positions us for continued growth through our trusted brand and award-winning multi-category product offerings. Since our launch, we have expanded our product availability, including the launch of strategic partnerships with Target, Amazon and Walmart in 2014, 2017 and 2022, respectively, as well as distribution with many other retailers nationwide. We have retail partnerships with leading retailers that sell our products through brick and mortar stores and on their own websites. Our retail partnerships expand brand awareness and product availability, creating meaningful marketing efficiencies as we continue to scale. Additionally, these retail partnerships support our differentiated value proposition by making our products conveniently available in the many places where our consumer shops.

Effective December 31, 2025, we have transitioned away from Honest.com as a shipping and fulfillment channel, while maintaining Honest.com as a resource for educating consumers, showcasing our complete product portfolio, and driving consumers to purchase through our leading retailers and their websites, and third-party ecommerce sites.

The core of our growth strategy centers around increasing physical and digital availability of our products, including through expanded stores, doors, aisles, shelves and facings. While we have made significant progress in our distribution gains, we are still under-indexed compared to competition. Our marketing strategy is focused on building a purpose-driven brand with deep connection to the community of shoppers we serve. We apply a modern, data-driven marketing approach and continuously innovate, optimize and identify new ways to reach and connect with our community. We believe this includes a best-in-class social media and influencer marketing strategy and a highly strategic approach to paid media.

In 2023, we executed a broad-based Transformation Initiative designed to build the Honest brand and drive growth in higher-margin areas of the portfolio, strengthen our cost structure, drive focus on the most productive areas of our business, deliver greater impact from brand-building investments, and improve executional excellence across the enterprise.
On October 30, 2025, our Board of Directors approved Transformation 2.0: Powering Honest Growth ("Powering

Honest Growth") which builds upon our original Transformation Pillars of Brand Maximization, Margin Enhancement and Operating Discipline. Powering Honest Growth is aimed at improving simplicity, focus and profitability, which includes exiting certain lower margin, non-strategic categories and channels, including exiting Honest.com fulfillment and apparel, as well as exiting retail and online stores in Canada, optimizing our cost structure by rightsizing selling, general and administrative expenses, and implementing supply chain efficiencies. We expect to substantially complete the actions under Powering Honest Growth by December 31, 2026.

Our strategic plan is grounded in our Transformation Pillars, which set the building blocks for long-term value creation. We expect to realize revenue growth of 4% to 6% annually and continued Adjusted EBITDA margin expansion.

We manage a global supply chain of highly qualified, third-party suppliers, including materials, components, manufacturing and logistics partners to produce and distribute our products. We look to identify and work with partners who share our commitment to quality, current Good Manufacturing Practices ("cGMPs"), clean ingredients in partnership with our Honest Standard, sustainability, and design. We conduct quality audits of our third-party partners and require that they follow our high standards of quality, including controlled documentation, cleaning and safety protocols, and laboratory controls. Our third-party partners are located in various locations including the United States, Mexico and China. Our supply chain team manages these relationships and processes and, with the support of our innovation team, researches materials, components and equipment, approves and manages purchasing plans, and oversees product fulfillment.

The primary raw materials and components of our products include responsibly sourced, plant-based fluff pulp in our diapers and plant-based substrate in our baby wipes, among other materials. Just as important as what goes into our products, we actively work with suppliers to avoid certain materials, including parabens, paraffins and synthetic fragrances, that don't meet our standards but are commonly used by mainstream brands.

Our distribution network includes two warehouses in Nevada and Pennsylvania, respectively, with retail fulfillment capabilities and value-added services operated by National Distribution Centers, LLC, or NFI, and GEODIS Logistics LLC, or GEODIS, respectively. The warehouse in Las Vegas is a state-of-the-art facility leased by Honest with a focus on automated large scale retail fulfillment. We manage inventory by forecasting demand tied to consumption and marketing campaigns, as well as analyzing product sell-through, and analyzing our supply chain to ensure sufficient capacity to support demand. As a result of global pandemics or other macroeconomic trends, we and our distribution partners have in the past experienced and may in the future experience some supply-related disruptions to the operations of our fulfillment centers. As part of Powering Honest Growth, in December 2025, we notified GEODIS, pursuant to the terms of the contract, that we are terminating the agreement with them for the Pennsylvania warehouse use and services effective June 30, 2026. Following June 30, 2026, we will only be operating with the Nevada warehouse.

The markets in which we operate are highly competitive and rapidly evolving, with many new brands and product offerings emerging in the marketplace. We face significant competition from both established, well-known legacy consumer packaged goods, or CPG players and emerging DTC brands. Select competitors of our wipes include ZURU Edge Limited (maker of Millie Moon and Rascals), WaterWipes UC, DUDE Wipes, Inc., Edgewell Personal Care Company (maker of Wet Ones wipes) and other private label brands. Select competitors of our skin and personal care products include Kimberly-Clark Corporation (pending acquiror of Kenvue Inc.), The Clorox Company (parent company of Burt's Bees, Inc.), Unilever PLC (maker of Shea Moisture), Estée Lauder Inc., L'Oréal S.A. and Pacifica Beauty LLC. Select competitors of our diapers include Kimberly-Clark Corporation (maker of Huggies diapers and Cottonelle wipes) and Procter & Gamble Company (maker of Pampers, Pampers Pure, Luvs and Charmin). We compete based on various product attributes including clean formulation, sustainability, effectiveness and design. We believe that we compete favorably across these factors taken as a whole.

Our product-level point of sale consumption growth in 2025 significantly outpaced the category in wipes and baby personal care, while decline in point of sale consumption for diapers in 2025 also outpaced the category. Based on independent third-party consumption data for the 52 weeks ended January 4, 2026, the point of sale consumption growth for wipes and baby personal care was 31% and 12%, respectively, and point of sale consumption for diapers declined 15%, each significantly outpacing the products in the industry as a whole which grew in wipes and baby personal care of 5% and 3%, respectively, and declined in diapers of 1%.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business, Our Brand, Our Products and Our Industry
Our quarterly operating results may fluctuate, which could cause our stock price to decline.
Our future success depends, in part, on our ability to achieve our long-term strategy.
We may be unable to accurately forecast revenue, gross margin or operating expenses and appropriately plan our expenses in the future.
We may not be able to compete successfully in our highly competitive market.
Overall macroeconomic trends, including due to geopolitical uncertainty, have had and may continue to have an adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects.
If we fail to manage our inventory effectively, our business, financial condition, results of operations and liquidity may be materially and adversely affected.
Failure to introduce new products may adversely affect our ability to continue to grow.

Failure to leverage our brand value propositions to compete against private label products, especially during an economic downturn, may adversely affect our ability to achieve or maintain profitability.
If we fail to develop and maintain our brand, our business could suffer.

Economic downturns or a change in consumer preferences, perception and spending habits in the clean products categories, in particular, could limit consumer demand for our products and negatively affect our business.
If we cannot maintain our Company culture or focus on our purpose as we grow, our success and our business and competitive position may be harmed.
Our ability to maintain our competitive position is largely dependent on the services of our senior management and other key personnel.
paragraphs: Investing in our common stock involves a high degree of risk. You should carefully consider the following risk factors, as well as the other information in this Form 10-K, including our consolidated financial statements and the related notes and "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations," before deciding whether to invest in shares of our common stock. The risks and uncertainties described below are not the only ones we face. Additional risks and uncertainties that we are unaware of, or that we currently believe are not material, may also become important factors that adversely affect our business. If any of the following risks actually occurs, our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects could be adversely affected. In this case, the trading price of our common stock could decline and you might lose part or all your investment.

Our past growth may not be indicative of our future growth and we may not be able to effectively manage our future growth or evaluate our future prospects. If we fail to effectively manage our future growth or evaluate our future prospects, our business could be adversely affected.

Past growth has placed demands on our management, financial, operational, technological and other resources. The anticipated growth and expansion of our business depends on a number of factors, including our ability to:
•increase awareness of our brand and successfully compete with other companies; •effectively market our products through retail partnerships to increase sales velocity;
•price our products effectively so that we are able to attract new consumers and expand sales to our existing consumers;
•expand distribution and points of sales (the number of SKUs) with new and existing consumers;

The Honest Standard, the Company's rigorous set of guiding principles that shape every step of product innovation and development, reflects Honest's ongoing dedication to safety, transparency and integrity. As a leader in clean and sustainable products, Honest continues to set a new standard for clean formulations, bringing joy to a community that seeks authenticity, transparency and efficacy in everyday essentials. Honest products are available nationwide at major retailers, including Amazon, Target and Walmart.

Effective December 31, 2025, we have transitioned away from Honest.com as a shipping and fulfillment channel, while maintaining Honest.com as a resource for educating consumers, showcasing our complete product portfolio, and driving consumers to purchase through our leading retailers and their websites, and third-party ecommerce sites.

The restructuring element of the Transformation Initiative was substantially completed by December 31, 2023.

In October 2025, our Board of Directors approved Transformation 2.0: Powering Honest Growth ("Powering Honest Growth") which builds upon our original Transformation Pillars of Brand Maximization, Margin Enhancement and Operating Discipline. Powering Honest Growth is aimed at improving simplicity, focus and profitability, which includes exiting certain lower margin, non-strategic categories and channels, including exiting Honest.com fulfillment and apparel, as well as exiting retail and online stores in Canada, optimizing our cost structure by rightsizing selling, general and administrative expenses and implementing supply chain efficiencies.
Powering Honest Growth is projected to result in the following:

•Costs associated with Powering Honest Growth, including restructuring costs, are expected to be approximately $30.0 million to $35.0 million to be recognized through the first quarter of 2027. During the year ended December 31, 2025, we have recognized $24.0 million of total costs related to Powering Honest Growth. See table below for additional details of total costs.

◦Of this range, we expect approximately $5.0 million to $8.0 million to be related to restructuring costs, primarily comprising contractual and external obligation costs, employee and personnel-related costs and asset and other restructuring-related costs, and approximately $25.0 million to $27.0 million to be related to other costs included in cost of revenue, primarily related to a discrete inventory write-down related to exiting apparel, fixed asset impairments, and costs associated with the warehouse closure, some of which

have already been incurred. For the year ended December 31, 2025, we have recognized $4.2 million in restructuring costs and $19.8 million in cost of revenue included on the consolidated statements of comprehensive loss.

•Powering Honest Growth is expected to result in annualized benefits in the range of approximately $10.0 million to $15.0 million, and the Company expects to begin seeing benefits in 2026. These benefits include reduction in costs of revenue and reduction in operating expenses, offset by a decrease in revenue related to the exit of lower margin non-strategic portfolios.

•The cash impact of costs related to Powering Honest Growth is expected to be in the range of approximately $15.0 million to $20.0 million for the full year 2026, with an immaterial amount of costs incurred during the year ended December 31, 2025 and the remainder to be incurred in 2026 and 2027.

•We expect the restructuring element of Powering Honest Growth to be substantially completed by December 31, 2026. We may incur other costs or cash expenditures not currently contemplated as a result of or in connection with Powering Honest Growth.

paragraphs: 於2012年成立，本公司（the "Company," 或 "Honest," 或亦可能稱為 "we," "us" 或 "our"）為一家個人護理公司，致力於為從嬰兒至成人皆提供潔淨配方且可持續設計的產品。透過結合深思熟慮的設計與科學創新，我們提供個人護理產品，服務從嬰兒至成人，涵蓋擦拭布、個人護理、尿布與美容等多個類別。我們對核心價值觀的承諾、持續創新以及與社羣互動，使我們的品牌與產品得以區隔並提升。自我們發行以來，我們已建立深厚的消費者信任，針對消費者最關心的事項：他們的健康、家庭與家屋。我們力求在消費者想要購物的地方提供服務，平衡深入的消費者連結與廣泛的便利性與可取得性。我們相信我們的通路策略使我們能持續成長，透過我們受信任的品牌與獲獎的多類別產品組合。

本公司首席執行官作為首席營運決策者，負責組織本公司、管理資源配置，並以一個營運分部為基礎衡量績效。我們提供一系列潔淨配方且可持續設計的產品，包括擦拭布組合與為從嬰兒至成人設計的個人護理系列，以及尿布。我們使用潔淨配方且安全的成分，適合全家人使用，包括許多天然來源的成分，最重要的是，這些成分具備有效性。我們也提供一系列擦拭布，包括多功能擦拭布、可沖洗的擦拭布（分為嬰兒與成人版本）、消毒擦拭布與卸妝擦拭布。我們的 Clean Conscious® 系列擦拭布為可堆肥且植物基製成，含有超過99%的水，設計用以保護敏感肌膚。我們擁有為從嬰兒至成人設計的廣泛個人護理產品組合，以及為不同膚質與膚況設計的成人臉部護理產品，其中許多產品已獲得受信任的專家與機構認證，包括國家濕疹協會。我們的成分與配方已由毒理學家進行審查，以評估潛在健康風險。我們尿布的主要零組件包括 responsibly sourced、植物基的纖維 pulp 與其他植物衍生材料。我們的尿布擁有現代且高效的設計，使用較少的材料。

我們力求在消費者想要購物的地方提供服務，平衡深入的消費者連結與廣泛的便利性與可取得性。我們的通路策略使我們能持續成長，透過我們受信任的品牌與獲獎的多類別產品組合。自我們發行以來，我們已擴展產品的可取得性，包括於2014年、2017年與2022年分別與Target、Amazon與Walmart建立戰略合作夥伴關係，以及與許多其他全國性零售通路合作。我們與領導零售通路有零售合作夥伴關係，這些通路透過實體門市與自己的網站銷售我們的產品。我們的零售合作夥伴關係擴大品牌知名度與產品可取得性，創造出在持續擴張過程中的有意義行銷效率。此外，這些零售合作夥伴關係也支持我們的差異化價值主張，使我們的產品在消費者購物的許多地方都能方便取得。
自2025年12月31日起，我們已從Honest.com這個物流與配送通路中脫離，同時維持Honest.com作為教育消費者、展示我們完整產品組合與引導消費者透過我們的領導零售通路與其網站，以及第三方電商網站進行購買的資源。

我們成長策略的核心在於增加我們產品的實體與數位可取得性，包括透過擴展商店、門口、走道、架位與展示面。雖然我們在通路擴張方面已取得顯著進展，但我們與競爭對手相比仍處於落後地位。我們的行銷策略聚焦於建立一個以使命為導向的品牌，與我們服務的購物社羣有深入的連結。我們採用現代、數據驅動的行銷方法，並持續創新、優化與尋找新的方式來接觸與連結我們的社羣。我們相信這包括最佳的社羣媒體與影響者行銷策略，以及高度戰略性的付費媒體方法。
在2023年，我們執行了一項廣泛的轉型計畫，旨在強化Honest品牌並推動高毛利率領域的成長，強化我們的成本結構，聚焦於我們業務中最具生產力的領域，提高品牌建設投資的影響力，並提升企業整體的執行卓越性。

於2025年10月30日，我們的董事會批准了轉型2.0：Powering Honest Growth（"Powering Honest Growth"），這項計畫建立在我們原始轉型支柱：品牌最大化、毛利率提升與營運紀律的基礎上。Powering Honest Growth旨在提升簡潔性、聚焦度與盈利能力，包括退出某些低毛利率、非戰略性的產品類別與通路，包括退出Honest.com的物流與服飾業務，以及退出加拿大零售與線上商店，優化我們的成本結構，透過調整銷售、總務與行政費用，並實施供應鏈效率提升措施。我們預期在2026年12月31日前 substantially 完成Powering Honest Growth下的行動。

Honest Growth") 建立在本公司原始的轉型四大支柱，即品牌最大化、毛利率提升與運營紀律之上。Powering Honest Growth 的目標在於提升簡潔性、聚焦度與獲利能力，包括退出部分低毛利率、非戰略性類別與通路，包括退出 Honest.com 的物流與服飾業務，以及退出加拿大零售與線上商店，透過調整營銷、總務與行政費用規模，優化成本結構，並落實供應鏈效率。本公司預期於 2026 年 12 月 31 日前 substantially complete 這些行動。
本公司戰略計畫以轉型支柱為基礎，這些轉型支柱設定了長遠價值創造的基礎。我們預期每年實現營業收入成長4%至6%，並持續擴大調整後營運資金邊際率。

我們管理一個全球供應鏈，包含高度合格的第三方供應商，包括材料、零組件、製造與物流夥伴，用以生產與分銷我們的產品。我們尋找並與具備與本公司相同品質承諾、符合現行良好製造實務（"cGMPs"）、與我們誠實標準合作的清潔原料、永續性與設計的夥伴合作。我們對第三方夥伴進行品質審查，並要求他們遵循我們高標準的品質，包括受控文件、清潔與安全作業程序，以及實驗室控制。我們的第三方夥伴位於不同地區，包括美國、墨西哥與中國。我們的供應鏈團隊管理這些關係與流程，並在創新團隊的支持下，研究材料、零組件與設備，批准並管理採購計畫，並監督產品履行。
我們產品的主要原料與零組件包括 responsibly sourced、植物基的 fluff pulp 在尿布中，以及植物基的 substrate 在嬰兒濕巾中，以及其他材料。與我們產品中所使用的材料一樣重要的是，我們積極與供應商合作，避免使用某些材料，包括 parabens、paraffins 與合成香料，這些材料不符合我們的標準，但卻常見於主流品牌中。

我們的分銷網路包括位於內華達州與賓夕法尼亞州的兩個倉庫，零售履行能力與附加價值服務由 National Distribution Centers, LLC，或 NFI，以及 GEODIS Logistics LLC，或 GEODIS，分別運營。位於拉斯維加斯的倉庫是一個先進的設施，由 Honest 租用，專注於自動化的大規模零售履行。我們透過預測與消費與行銷活動相關的需求，以及分析產品銷售情況，並分析供應鏈以確保足夠的容量來支撐需求來管理存貨。由於全球疫情或其他總體經濟趨勢，我們與分銷夥伴過去曾經驗並可能未來經驗某些與履行中心運作相關的供應問題。根據 Powering Honest Growth 計畫，在 2025 年 12 月，我們依照契約條款通知 GEODIS，我們將於 2026 年 6 月 30 日終止與他們就賓夕法尼亞州倉庫使用與服務的契約。在 2026 年 6 月 30 日之後，我們將僅使用內華達州的倉庫進行營運。

我們所經營的市場高度競爭且快速演進，許多新品牌與產品選擇不斷湧現。我們面臨來自已建立、知名消費包裝商品（CPG）業者與新興直營品牌的重大競爭。我們濕巾的選擇性競爭對手包括 ZURU Edge Limited（製造 Millie Moon 與 Rascals 的公司）、WaterWipes UC、DUDE Wipes, Inc.、Edgewell Personal Care Company（製造 Wet Ones 潤濕巾的公司）以及其他自有品牌。我們皮膚與個人護理產品的選擇性競爭對手包括 Kimberly-Clark Corporation（待收購 Kenvue Inc. 的公司）、The Clorox Company（Burt's Bees, Inc. 的母公司）、Unilever PLC（製造 Shea Moisture 的公司）、Estée Lauder Inc.、L'Oréal S.A. 以及 Pacifica Beauty LLC。我們尿布的選擇性競爭對手包括 Kimberly-Clark Corporation（製造 Huggies 尿布與 Cottonelle 潤濕巾的公司）與 Procter & Gamble Company（製造 Pampers、Pampers Pure、Luvs 與 Charmin 的公司）。我們的競爭基於多種產品特性，包括清潔配方、永續性、有效性與設計。我們相信我們在這些因素整體上具有競爭優勢。

我們在 2025 年的產品層級零售消費成長遠遠超過濕巾與嬰兒個人護理類別，同時 2025 年尿布的零售消費下降也遠遠超過類別。根據獨立第三方的零售消費數據，截至 2026 年 1 月 4 日的 52 週，濕巾與嬰兒個人護理的零售消費成長為 31% 與 12%，而尿布的零售消費下降為 15%，每種產品均遠遠超過整體產業產品的成長與下降幅度，其中濕巾與嬰兒個人護理的成長為 5% 與 3%，而尿布的下降為 1%。

paragraphs: 你應閱讀下列對我們財務狀況與營運成果之分析，並與本年度10-K年度報告中所包含之合併財務報表及相關附註一併參考。此討論，特別是關於我們未來營運成果或財務狀況、商業策略與計畫，以及管理階層對未來營運之目標，包含風險與不確定性，如本年度10-K年度報告中「特別注意前瞻性陳述」標題下所述。你應審閱本年度10-K年度報告中「風險因素」標題下的揭露，以瞭解可能導致我們實際結果與這些前瞻性陳述中預期結果有重大差異的重要因素。除非文意另有要求，否則本年度10-K年度報告中所有提及「我們」、「我們」、「我們的」、「我們公司」、「本公司」及「Honest」之參考，均指The Honest Company, Inc.及其合併子公司。
關於我們2025年12月31日財務狀況與營運成果與2024年12月31日財務狀況與營運成果之比較討論，請見下文。關於我們2024年12月31日財務狀況與營運成果與2023年12月31日財務狀況與營運成果之比較討論，請參閱我們2024年12月31日年度報告中「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之分析」項目（Item 7），該報告已於2025年2月26日提交至證券交易委員會（SEC）。

The Honest Company（「本公司」或「Honest」，亦可能稱為「我們」、「我們」或「我們的」）於2012年成立，是一家專注於為從嬰兒到成人提供潔淨配方與可持續設計產品的個人護理公司。透過結合深思熟慮的設計與科學創新，我們為從嬰兒到成人提供個人護理產品，涵蓋擦拭布、個人護理、尿布與美容等多個類別。我們對核心價值觀的承諾、持續創新與與社區互動，使我們的品牌與產品得以區隔與提升。自我們啟動以來，我們已建立深厚的消費者信任，他們最關心的事物：健康、家庭與家屋。我們致力於在消費者想要購物的地方提供服務，平衡深入的消費者連結與廣泛的便利性與可取得性。我們相信我們的通路策略使我們能透過受信任的品牌與獲獎的多類別產品組合持續成長。
The Honest Standard為本公司嚴謹的指導原則，用以塑造產品創新與開發的每一步驟，反映Honest持續致力於安全、透明與誠信的承諾。作為潔淨與可持續產品的領導者，Honest持續設立潔淨配方的新標準，為尋求真實性、透明度與日常必需品效果的社羣帶來歡樂。Honest產品全國各處的大型零售通路均有販售，包括Amazon、Target與Walmart。
自2025年12月31日起，我們已從Honest.com作為物流與配送通路轉移，同時維持Honest.com作為教育消費者、展示完整產品組合與引導消費者透過我們的領導零售通路及其網站，以及第三方電商網站進行購買的資源。
2023年，我們執行了一項廣泛的轉型計畫，旨在強化Honest品牌並推動高毛利率領域的成長，強化成本結構，聚焦於我們業務中最具生產力的領域，提高品牌建設投資的影響力，並提升企業的執行卓越性。轉型計畫的重整部分於2023年12月31日已 substantially 完成。

2025年10月，我們董事會批准了轉型2.0：Powering Honest Growth（「Powering Honest Growth」），這項計畫建立在我們原始轉型支柱：品牌最大化、毛利提升與運營紀律之上。Powering Honest Growth旨在提升簡潔性、聚焦與利潤率，包括退出某些低毛利、非戰略類別與通路，包括退出Honest.com的物流與服飾，以及退出加拿大零售與線上商店，透過調整營銷、總務與行政費用，優化成本結構，並實施供應鏈效率。
Powering Honest Growth預期會產生以下結果：
◦此範圍中，我們預期約 5.0 百萬美元至 8.0 百萬美元與重組成本有關，主要包含契約及外部義務成本、員工及人事相關成本以及資產及其他重組相關成本，約 25.0 百萬美元至 27.0 百萬美元與其他包含在營業成本中的成本有關，主要與退出服飾業務的離散存貨減記、固定資產減損以及倉庫關閉相關的成本有關，其中部分
已產生相關費用。於截至2025年12月31日之會計年度，本公司已於綜合損益表中認列4.2 百萬美元之重組費用，以及19.8 百萬美元之營業收入成本。
•Powering Honest Growth 預期將帶來每年約 10.0 百萬美元至 15.0 百萬美元的效益，且本公司預期將於 2026 年開始看見效益。這些效益包括營收成本的減少與營運費用的減少，但會因較低毛利率非戰略性 portfolio 的退出而導致營收減少所抵銷。
•與Powering Honest Growth相關的成本現金影響，預期於2026年全年範圍約為15.0 百萬美元至20.0 百萬美元，其中於2025年12月31日為結業年度所產生的成本為無重大金額，餘下部分將於2026年及2027年產生。
•本公司預期Powering Honest Growth之重整部分將於2026年12月31日 substantially 完成。本公司可能因Powering Honest Growth而產生其他未預期之成本或現金支出。

headings: 與我們業務、品牌、產品及產業相關的風險
我們的季節性營運結果可能出現波動，這可能會導致本公司股票價格下跌。
我們未來的成功，在一定程度上取決於我們實現長期戰略的能力。
我們可能無法準確預測營業收入、毛利率或營運費用，並在未來適當規劃費用。
我們可能無法在高度競爭的市場中成功競爭。
總體經濟趨勢，包括因地緣政治不確定性所導致的影響，已對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運結果及前景產生並可能繼續產生不利影響。
若我們無法有效管理存貨，將可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運結果及流動性產生重大且不利的影響。
未能推出新產品可能對我們持續成長的能力產生不利影響。
未能善用我們的品牌價值主張來與自有品牌產品競爭，尤其在經濟衰退期間，可能會不利於我們實現或維持獲利能力。
若我們未能發展並維持品牌，將可能對我們的業務造成影響。
總體經濟衰退或潔淨產品類別中消費者偏好、觀感與消費習慣的改變，可能會限制消費者對我們產品的需求，並對我們的業務產生負面影響。
若我們無法在成長過程中維持本公司文化或專注於我們的使命，將可能損害我們的成功以及業務與競爭地位。
我們維持競爭地位的能力 largely 依賴於高階管理階層及其他關鍵人員的服務。
paragraphs: 投資本公司的普通股涉及高度風險。您應仔細考慮下列風險因素，以及本 Form 10-K 的其他資訊，包括我們的合併財務報表及相關附註，以及「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之分析」，再決定是否投資本公司普通股。上述描述的風險與不確定性並非我們唯一面臨的風險。我們可能還會面臨其他未預見或目前認為不具重大影響的風險與不確定性，這些因素可能對我們的業務產生不利影響。若上述任何風險實際發生，將可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果與前景產生不利影響。在此情況下，本公司普通股的交易價格可能下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資。
我們過去的成長可能無法反映未來的成長，我們可能無法有效管理未來的成長或評估未來的前景。若我們無法有效管理未來的成長或評估未來的前景，將可能對我們的業務產生不利影響。
過去的成長已對我們的管理、財務、營運、技術及其他資源產生壓力。我們業務預期的成長與擴張取決於多種因素，包括我們是否能夠：
• 提升品牌知名度並成功與其他公司競爭；• 透過零售合作夥伴有效行銷產品以提高銷售速度；
• 有效訂價產品，使我們能夠吸引新消費者並擴大對現有消費者的銷售；
• 擴大分銷與銷售點（SKU 數量）至新舊消費者；
